title: Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
sourceNote: Official MoEFCC. The Ministry's Environment Protection page lists the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 and the Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986.

title: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act is identified as Act No. 14 of 1981 and administered by MoEFCC.

title: Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
edition: As amended by the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 2023
sourceNote: Official India Code. The current PDF reflects the 2023 amendment, including the change of short title and insertion of section 1A, effective 1 December 2023.

title: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
edition: 2026; effective 1 April 2026; supersedes Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016
sourceNote: Official Government PDF hosted by CPCB. The notification expressly supersedes the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016 and states that the 2026 Rules come into force on 1 April 2026. MoEFCC's current releases page lists S.O. 388(E).

title: Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
edition: 2016 with amendments through 2024; latest verified amendment 2024
sourceNote: Official MoEFCC. The 2024 amendment notification records the 2016 Rules and their successive amendments through 2023, then further amends them through G.S.R. 201(E) dated 14 March 2024.

title: Uttar Pradesh Minor Minerals (Concession) Rules, 2021
edition: 2021; official India Code PDF with subsequent amendment material reflected in the repository
sourceNote: Official India Code / Government of Uttar Pradesh. The Rules supersede the Uttar Pradesh Minor Minerals (Concession) Rules, 1963 and apply throughout Uttar Pradesh. The current English PDF is dated/updated February 2026 while reproducing the 29 October 2021 notification.

title: Uttar Pradesh Protection of Trees Act, 1976
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act regulates felling/protection of specified trees in Uttar Pradesh and defines competent authorities and forest-related terms.
